versions.changelog:
- Clarified and updated content-policy details for image generation, replacing "NSFW" mentions with general prompt/content restrictions.
- Reformulated the NSFW and filter documentation section as general content filter notes and workarounds.
- Updated SKILL description to reference supported model types instead of NSFW caveats.
- No functional API or usage changes; documentation only.

Initial release of the freegen-image-generation skill.

- Provides a unified API to generate images via various TXT2IMG, IMG2IMG, Inpainting, RemoveBG, and Upscale modes using a local freegen Docker container.
- Supports multiple model categories: flux, SDXL, SD 1.5, SDXL Lightning, with detailed payload formats and sample requests.
- Documents clear NSFW caveats: Flux uncensored, but NSFW blocked in all image editing tools via Dezgo.
- Includes endpoint summary, error handling notes, available models, and example workflows for integration.
- Status table shows feature support and live test observations.
